readme.summary: Exceptionally well-structured with comprehensive examples for every supported validation library, but lacks any troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section — common issues like type inference failures, async vs sync mode gotchas, or peer dependency conflicts are undocumented.

common_complaints: TypeScript type errors with Zod v4.x (version mismatch in branded types)
Import path issues with modern bundlers (Vite, Next.js)
Type inference mismatches between resolver and schema types
Test suite failures not being addressed
Error handling gaps in Standard Schema resolver
praise_themes: Active community engagement on older issues (Aug 2025 issue has 29 comments)
sentiment.summary: Project shows declining maintenance: recent issues (Jan-Mar 2026) receive no responses, critical test failures go unaddressed, and recurring TypeScript compatibility issues with popular schema validators suggest maintainer capacity issues or shifted priorities.
